# Vetta 0.6.14
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- Plugin header buttons can now show more than an icon: a short label (such as the current branch), a semantic-coloured badge, and menus with checkboxes, section labels and one level of submenu.
- Plugin header actions can also appear on the new-session page. Each page remembers its own header layout.
- With Git, the header now shows your branch and how many files are uncommitted. Click it to switch branches, write a commit message, or fetch, pull and push without opening the activity panel.

## 中文

### 新增

- 插件的顶栏按钮不再只有图标：可以带一小段文字（比如当前分支）、带语义色的角标，菜单支持勾选、分组标题与一层子菜单。
- 插件动作也能出现在新会话页，两个页面各自记住自己的顶栏布局。
- 装了 Git 后顶栏会显示当前分支和未提交文件数，点开即可切分支、写提交、拉取或推送，不必打开活动面板。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.13...v0.6.14
